neerc-1998.notes: Source 1 (www.ifmo.ru/neerc/, Wayback 2001-10-05) captured only a robots.txt that disallows all robots; a new capture from another snapshot is needed if this site is to be kept.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw the ITMO university portal homepage; our copy now holds only a robots.txt served at the address in the 2001 Wayback snapshot, so nothing of the site can be read.
sources.evidence: Our copy is a single 75-byte text file, a robots.txt reading "User-agent: * Disallow: /", with no page of the site.

neerc-2010.notes: DMOJ holds 8 of the 11 problems (A-F, H, K); titles agree with the catalogue except that DMOJ's row reads "K - Graph Oddity" where the catalogue has "K-Graph Oddity".

sources.evidence: DMOJ problem list of eight rows titled "ICPC NEERC 2010 A - Alignment of Code" to "ICPC NEERC 2010 K - Graph Oddity".

neerc-2013.notes: QOJ lists all 11 problems A-K; titles and letters agree with the catalogue. Statements and Tutorials attachments were not captured.

sources.evidence: QOJ contest page headed "The 2013 Northeastern Europe Regional Contest (NEERC 2013)" with a table of 11 problems A to K.
